description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Bot, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice, and implements functionality to recognize bot user agents. It contains an array of signatures for various bots and methods to match user agent strings against these signatures and to identify the browser type as 'bot'.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Bot
classes.description: A class that detects whether a user agent is a bot based on predefined signatures, extending Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method that compares a user agent string and server parameters against known bot signatures to detect if the user agent is a bot.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Instance method that returns the string 'bot', indicating the user agent type.
